plugins.name: 操作电脑
plugins.description: 移动鼠标、点击、输入文字、按键、列出并切换窗口。危险：会给模型操作桌面的能力。
plugins.description_en: Move the mouse, click, type text, press keys, list and focus windows. Dangerous: gives the model control over your desktop.

plugins.name: 上下文洞察
plugins.description: 看一眼当前对话有多大：消息数、字数、估算 token、还能塞多少；以及把早期历史压成摘要。
plugins.description_en: Inspect the current conversation size (messages, chars, estimated tokens, headroom) and compress early history into a summary.

plugins.name: 记忆系统
plugins.description: 长期记忆：把用户偏好、事实记下来，需要时按关键词检索。存在本地 user:// 里，不上传。
plugins.description_en: Long-term memory: store facts, recall by keyword, local only.

plugins.name: 截图
plugins.description: 抓一张全屏截图存成 PNG，返回路径和分辨率（配合识图插件可以看图）。
plugins.description_en: Capture a full-screen PNG and return its path and resolution (works with the vision plugin to read it).

plugins.name: 终端
plugins.description: 在 Windows 上执行命令，把标准输出和退出码返回给模型。带危险命令黑名单。
plugins.description_en: Run commands on Windows and return output, with a dangerous-command denylist.

plugins.name: 网页搜索与获取
plugins.description: 抓取网页正文（curl 转纯文本）和 DuckDuckGo 关键词搜索，把结果喂给模型。
plugins.description_en: Fetch page text and search DuckDuckGo.
